description: A smartphone lies on a green bed sheet with a white charging cable nearby, and a large white board or panel leans against the wall in the background. The right hand moves in from the right to grasp and steady the phone, while the left hand slides in from the left to pick up the cable connector and guide it into the phone’s bottom port; once it’s seated, the left hand releases the cable and the right hand lowers the phone back onto the bed.
